playstyle.summary: Passive baseline and transition player who relies on upright, compact arm-driven motions rather than dynamic athletic footwork.
tendencies: Stands excessively upright during ready state and shot execution
Delivers reliable, conservative serves deep into the opponent's court
Relies mostly on arm extension rather than hip rotation or knee drive
playstyle.under_pressure: Tends to stiffen upright and reach with the paddle arm rather than dropping hips and stepping through the ball.

skills.basis: Consistent depth and mechanics demonstrated on serves at t=79.87s and t=91.51s.
Slow to close the kitchen line, often lingering upright in transition (e.g. t=44.75s, y=13.2 ft).
Puts returns and serves in play, but produces limited offensive penetration due to high center of gravity.

coaching.headline: Lower your center of gravity to build a dynamic athletic base
strengths: Dependable, controlled serve mechanics starting rallies cleanly (t=79.87s, 91.51s)
Calm court demeanor with minimal erratic paddle thrashing

top_priority_fix.issue: Severe lack of knee bend and athletic hinge across baseline, transition, and contact points.
top_priority_fix.why_it_matters: Operating with straight legs restricts court coverage, prevents driving through the ball from the lower body, and leads to mistimed, arm-only contacts.
top_priority_fix.evidence: Knee angle at contact measured at 171.1 degrees at t=12.30s, 174.7 degrees at t=44.75s, and 179.5 degrees at t=91.51s.

secondary.issue: Passive transition speed up to the kitchen line after hitting returns.
secondary.evidence: Remains in the mid-court transition zone (y=10.3 to 13.2 ft) during rallies 4 and 5 rather than pushing aggressively to the kitchen tape.

drills.name: Athletic Base Drops & Dinks
drills.targets: Maintain knee flexion between 135 and 145 degrees throughout ready stance and ball strike.
drills.reps_or_duration: 4 sets of 15 drops from mid-court and kitchen

drills.name: Split-Step and Sprint to NVZ
drills.targets: Hit a return from the baseline, perform a loaded split-step, and advance to the kitchen line before third ball crosses net.

data_gaps: No extended kitchen firefights or backhand reset exchanges were recorded in the clip to evaluate soft dinking touch or hand speed under direct pressure.
